products.name: Segway Ninebot KickScooter Max G2
products.verdict: The best electric scooter overall — 43-mile range, Apple Find My, and built-in turn signals in a tank-like build.
products.description: The Segway Ninebot Max G2 is the electric scooter that does everything well. Its 43-mile max range is the longest in the commuter class, powered by a 551Wh battery and a 450W motor that hits 22 mph. Built-in turn signals, a front suspension fork, and Apple Find My tracking add safety and peace of mind. The 10" pneumatic tires absorb bumps, and the IPX5 water resistance handles rain. It's the scooter that turns a commute into a joy ride.
pros: Built-in turn signals are a huge safety upgrade
Apple Find My for theft tracking
cons: Heavy at 44 lbs — hard to carry upstairs
22 mph feels slow for experienced riders

products.name: GOTRAX G4
products.verdict: The best budget commuter scooter — 25-mile range and 20 mph speed for under $500.
products.description: The GOTRAX G4 packs impressive specs into a budget-friendly package. Its 500W motor reaches 20 mph, and the battery delivers up to 25 miles of range — more than enough for most daily commutes. 10" pneumatic tires provide a comfortable ride, the dual braking system (electronic + rear disc) stops safely, and the foldable design makes it easy to carry on public transit. At under $500, it's the smartest entry into electric scooter commuting.
pros: Foldable for public transit and storage
cons: 500W motor still works hard on steep hills
Build quality is adequate, not premium

products.name: Hiboy S2 Pro
products.verdict: The best budget scooter with solid tires — maintenance-free 10" solids and 25-mile range at a low price.
products.description: The Hiboy S2 Pro is perfect for riders who never want to deal with flat tires. Its 10" solid honeycomb tires are puncture-proof and maintenance-free, while the 500W motor delivers 19 mph and the battery provides up to 25 miles of range. The rear suspension absorbs bumps that solid tires would otherwise transmit, and the foldable design with app connectivity makes it a practical daily commuter. At $459, it's outstanding value for a solid-tire scooter.
pros: Rear suspension compensates for solid tires
25-mile range at this price is competitive
Foldable and relatively light at 36 lbs
cons: Solid tires transmit more vibration than pneumatic

products.name: Segway Ninebot F2 Pro
products.verdict: The best mid-range Segway — long range, front suspension, and Segway reliability at a reasonable price.
products.description: The Segway Ninebot F2 Pro slots between budget scooters and the flagship Max G2, hitting a sweet spot of price and performance. Its motor reaches 20 mph, and the battery provides an impressive 25+ miles of range. The front suspension fork smooths out bumps, 10" self-sealing tubeless tires grip well and resist punctures, and the Segway app provides ride stats, speed mode settings, and firmware updates. At $649, it's the best Segway for riders who want great range without the Max G2 price tag.

products.name: GOTRAX XR Ultra
products.verdict: The best ultra-budget scooter — a foldable commuter with 17-mile range for under $350.
products.description: The GOTRAX XR Ultra is the cheapest electric scooter worth buying for daily use. Its 300W motor reaches 15.5 mph, and the LG battery provides up to 17 miles of range — enough for short commutes and errands. The 8.5" pneumatic tires provide a smoother ride than solid alternatives, and the foldable design makes it easy to store under a desk or carry onto a bus. At $349, it's the gateway into electric scooter commuting.
pros: Pneumatic tires ride smoother than solids
cons: 15.5 mph is slow for road use

products.name: NIU KQi3 Max
products.verdict: The best-riding mid-range scooter — 40-mile range, 9.5" tubeless tires, and a refined riding experience.
products.description: The NIU KQi3 Max comes from NIU, the world's largest electric two-wheeler company, and the engineering shows. The 450W motor with 40-mile range handles extended commutes without range anxiety, and the ride quality is among the smoothest in the mid-range category. 9.5" tubeless pneumatic tires resist punctures, the dual braking system stops confidently, and the NIU app provides ride tracking and firmware updates.
pros: 40-mile range is exceptional for the price
NIU's two-wheeler expertise shows in ride quality
